_doc: Bridge prefabs (docs/FARM_PLAN.md §6 rule 2), read by tools/blender/valley/build_valley_kit.py and src/valley/world/valleyGround.js so the modelled deck and the walkable deck are the same curve: y(t) = abutment + lift (planks flush with the abutment at both ends) + arch * sin(pi t), t = 0..1 along the span.
